title.zh: 卷423 列傳二百十 宗稷辰 尹耕雲 王拯 穆缉香阿 游百川 沈淮
title.en: Volume 423 Biographies 210: Zong Jichen, Yin Gengyun, Wang Zheng, Mu Jixianga, You Baichuan, Shen Huai
title.raw: 卷423 列傳二百十 宗稷辰 尹耕雲 王拯 穆缉香阿 游百川 沈淮

sentences.zh: =宗稷辰= 宗稷辰，字滌甫，浙江會稽人。

translations.literal: =Zong Jichen= Zong Jichen, style name Difu, was a native of Kuaiji in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Jichen, whose style name was Difu, came from Kuaiji in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 道光元年舉人，授內閣中書，充軍機章京。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Daoguang reign he passed the provincial examination, was appointed Secretariat Drafter in the Grand Secretariat, and served as a clerk on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: He earned his juren degree in Daoguang 1 (1821), was appointed a Grand Secretariat drafter, and served as a clerk on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 遷起居注主事，再遷戶部員外郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Recorder of the Emperor's Actions as a director, and again transferred to an assistant department director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to director in the Office of the Imperial Diary, then again to assistant director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，遷御史。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Xianfeng reign he was transferred to censor.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 1 (1851) he was made a censor.

sentences.zh: 疏請飭各省實行保甲，略言：「州縣宜久任，時日宜寬假，填寫門牌當詳細核對，董事胥役毋派費累民，酌用丞簿以為襄助，先編巨族以為聯屬，並可申明讀法之典，兼收團練、社倉之益。

translations.literal: He memorialized urging each province to carry out the baojia system in earnest, stating in summary: "Prefects and magistrates should hold office for long terms, deadlines should allow ample time, door-placard registers should be checked in detail, clerks in charge must not levy fees and burden the people, assistant prefects and registrars should be employed judiciously as aides, great clans should first be enrolled to form mutual ties, and one may also proclaim the ritual of collective reading, while reaping the benefits of militia training and community granaries."
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial urging the provinces to enforce the baojia household-registration system in earnest. He argued that magistrates needed long tenures and reasonable deadlines; door placards needed careful verification; clerks must not pad fees at the people's expense; deputy prefects and registrars could serve as aides; great clans should be registered first to form mutual ties; collective reading rituals could be proclaimed; and militia drill together with community granaries would bring further benefit.

sentences.zh: 」詔下直省督撫，各就地體察參酌行之。

translations.literal: "An edict was sent down to governors-general and governors of all provinces, each to investigate on the spot and enact after due deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered each provincial governor to assess local conditions and implement the plan as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 又疏言通籌出入，宜崇實去偽，舉清查、報效、生息三端；

translations.literal: He again memorialized on coordinating revenue and expenditure, stating that truthfulness should be honored and falsity rejected, citing three measures: thorough investigation, voluntary contributions, and interest-bearing reserves;
translations.idiomatic: In another memorial on balancing revenue and expenditure, he urged scrapping pretense for solid facts, and set forth three measures: rigorous audits, voluntary buyouts of office, and interest-bearing reserves.

sentences.zh: 又疏請酌改經徵處，分令州縣戴罪嚴催：並下戶部覈議。

translations.literal: He again memorialized requesting appropriate revision of collection points, ordering prefectures and counties to urge collection strictly under liability for fault: and this was referred to the Ministry of Revenue for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that tax collection be reorganized and that prefects and magistrates be ordered to press collection under personal liability; the proposal was sent to the Ministry of Revenue for review.

sentences.zh: 五年，聞上將謁陵，未有旨戒行，稷辰疏言：「畿南州縣被水，連歲用兵，民氣甫行休息，籥請展緩一年。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, hearing that the emperor was about to visit the imperial tombs and no edict had yet warned against travel, Jichen memorialized: "The prefectures and counties south of the capital have suffered flooding, and war has continued for years; the people's morale has only just begun to recover—I venture to request postponement for one year."
translations.idiomatic: In his fifth year as censor, learning that the emperor planned a tomb visit though no travel restriction had been announced, Jichen memorialized that the flooded districts south of the capital, after years of war, had only begun to catch their breath, and he begged a year's postponement.

sentences.zh: 」上諭曰：「每歲謁陵，事同典禮，如果畿輔民力未逮，亦必權衡時勢，暫緩舉行。

translations.literal: "The emperor instructed: "The annual tomb visit is a matter of ritual propriety; if the people of the capital region cannot bear the burden, times must be weighed and the ceremony temporarily deferred."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied that the annual tomb pilgrimage was a ritual obligation, but if the capital region's people could not bear it, the court must weigh the times and defer the rite.

sentences.zh: 今茲並未降旨何日謁陵，宗稷辰揣度陳奏，徒博敢諫之名而無其實。

translations.literal: This year no edict has yet fixed the date of the visit; Zong Jichen surmised and submitted a memorial, merely courting a reputation for daring remonstrance without substance.
translations.idiomatic: Yet no date had even been set for this year's visit—Jichen had only guessed and spoken up, winning a name for bold remonstrance without the substance to match.

sentences.zh: 此風不可長！

translations.literal: This practice must not be encouraged!
translations.idiomatic: Such conduct must not be indulged!

sentences.zh: 」下部議處。

translations.literal: "The matter was referred to the relevant ministry for disciplinary action.
translations.idiomatic: The case was referred to the ministries for disciplinary handling.

sentences.zh: 尋又奏言：「自粵匪竄據長江，數年以來，文臣武將，能戰者稀。

translations.literal: Soon he again submitted: "Since the Cantonese rebels seized the Yangtze, over several years civil and military officials who could fight have been few."
translations.idiomatic: He soon submitted another memorial: "Since the Taiping rebels seized the Yangtze, capable civil and military commanders have been scarce for years."

sentences.zh: 如烏蘭泰、塔齊布、江忠源皆難得之將，而多不盡其用，且以死殉。

translations.literal: Such men as Ulanga, Taqibu, and Jiang Zhongyuan were all generals hard to come by, yet many were not fully employed and died in service.
translations.idiomatic: Men such as Ulanga, Taqibu, and Jiang Zhongyuan were generals of rare quality, yet the court often failed to use them fully, and they died in the field.

sentences.zh: 如勝保、張亮基、袁甲三皆勇於任事，而亦未盡其用，以罪罷去。

translations.literal: Such men as Shengbao, Zhang Liangji, and Yuan Jiasan were all bold in undertaking affairs, yet they too were not fully employed and were dismissed for faults.
translations.idiomatic: Shengbao, Zhang Liangji, and Yuan Jiasan were all willing to take on hard duties, yet they too were not fully used and were removed on charges.

sentences.zh: 近日支持兩湖，賴有一二書生，如胡林翼、羅澤南，能以練膽為士卒先。

translations.literal: Recently in holding up Hunan and Hubei, reliance has fallen on one or two scholars such as Hu Linyi and Luo Zinan, who could take the lead in drilling and steeling the troops.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the defense of Hunan and Hubei has rested on a few scholar-officers such as Hu Linyi and Luo Zinan, who led by example in drilling and hardening their men.

sentences.zh: 此二人者，實曾國籓有以開之。

translations.literal: These two men in fact had their path opened by Zeng Guofan.
translations.idiomatic: In fact Zeng Guofan had opened the way for both of them.

sentences.zh: 此時若開文武兼資一科，誠足濟當時之急，而臣工多不敢薦舉者，一恐其才疏而得過，一恐其遇蹇而罔功。

translations.literal: At this time if an examination for men combining civil and military talent were opened, it would truly suffice to meet the urgent need of the day, yet many officials dare not recommend anyone—one fearing that if talent proves shallow they will be faulted, another fearing that if fortune proves adverse no merit will be achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Opening a special examination for men skilled in both civil and military affairs would truly meet the urgent need of the hour, yet many officials dare not recommend anyone—fearing blame if the nominee proves incompetent, or futility if fortune turns against him.

sentences.zh: 處愁眉焚頂之時，守蹈常習故之轍，見有敗衄，動以餉匱為辭。

translations.literal: In a time when brows are knit and heads burn with worry, they cling to the old beaten track; when defeat occurs, they invariably plead shortage of pay.
translations.idiomatic: In an hour when worry presses from every side, they cling to routine; at every defeat they plead empty coffers.

sentences.zh: 餉固不可不籌，試思用兵乏人，雖斂金百萬，棄如土苴，終歸無用。

translations.literal: Pay certainly cannot go unplanned, but consider: if in war men are lacking, though a million in gold be levied, it is cast away like dirt and straw and in the end proves useless.
translations.idiomatic: Supplies must be planned, but without capable commanders even a million in silver is worthless—money alone cannot win a war.

sentences.zh: 臣聞見隘陋，非能盡識天下之才，所知湖南有左宗棠，通權達變，為疆吏所倚重，若使獨當一面，必不下於林翼、澤南。

translations.literal: Your servant's knowledge is narrow and shallow and cannot encompass all talent under Heaven; among those known to him in Hunan is Zuo Zongtang, versatile and resourceful, relied upon by frontier officials—if entrusted with independent command, he would certainly not rank below Linyi and Zenan.
translations.idiomatic: My own knowledge is limited and cannot compass every talent in the empire, but in Hunan I know Zuo Zongtang—resourceful, adaptable, and trusted by frontier governors. Given independent command, he would not rank below Hu Linyi or Luo Zinan.

sentences.zh: 其屢經論薦，難進易退，肝膽經術，實可取材者，有若湖州之姚承輿。

translations.literal: Among those repeatedly discussed and recommended, hard to advance and easy to withdraw, yet with courage and classical learning truly fit for employment, is Yao Chengyu of Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Among men often discussed in memorials—slow to advance yet quick to withdraw, but possessed of courage and classical learning—Yao Chengyu of Huzhou is truly fit for service.

sentences.zh: 其策議深沉，才識過人者，有若常州之週騰虎、管晏，桂林之唐啟華，皆關心時務，今尚鬱鬱伏處田間。

translations.literal: Among those whose policy deliberations are profound and whose talent and insight surpass others are Zhou Tenghu and Guan Yan of Changzhou and Tang Qihua of Guilin—all concerned with current affairs, yet still dwelling in obscurity in the countryside.
translations.idiomatic: Men of deep policy insight and outstanding ability include Zhou Tenghu and Guan Yan of Changzhou and Tang Qihua of Guilin—all engaged with public affairs, yet still living in obscurity in the countryside.

sentences.zh: 誠能破格招賢，連茹並進，則得一人可以平數州，得數人可以清一路。

translations.literal: If the throne can truly break precedent to recruit the worthy and advance them in clusters like linked roots, then gaining one man can pacify several prefectures, and gaining several men can clear a whole circuit.
translations.idiomatic: If the court would break precedent to recruit talent in clusters, one able man could pacify several prefectures, and several such men could clear an entire circuit.

sentences.zh: 長江雖阻，當不難分道建功，剋日平定。

translations.literal: Though the Yangtze be an obstacle, it should not be hard to achieve merit on separate fronts and bring pacification within a set day.
translations.idiomatic: Though the Yangtze stands in the way, forces could strike on separate fronts and bring the rebellion to an end in due course.

sentences.zh: 伏乞皇上命內外臣工各舉所知，無論已仕未仕，果能文武兼資，皆許徵起，必可網羅而盡得之。

translations.literal: Your servant humbly begs the emperor to order civil and military officials within and without to each recommend those they know; whether already in office or not, if they truly combine civil and military ability, all may be summoned forth, and talent can surely be gathered in full.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly beg Your Majesty to order officials everywhere to recommend those they know—whether already in office or not—and to summon all who truly combine civil and military talent, so that no able man is left out.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，下各督撫，命以宗棠等加考送部引見。

translations.literal: "When the memorial entered, it was sent down to each governor-general and governor, ordering that Zongtang and the others undergo additional examination and be forwarded to the ministry for imperial audience.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, the throne ordered the governors to examine Zuo Zongtang and the others further and send them to the capital for audience.

sentences.zh: 宗棠自此膺簡拔，論者謂其知人。

translations.literal: From this Zongtang received selection and promotion; commentators said he knew men.
translations.idiomatic: From this Zuo Zongtang won imperial selection, and commentators praised Jichen for knowing talent when he saw it.

sentences.zh: 遷給事中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 時京師行大錢，商民苦之。

translations.literal: At the time the capital circulated large-value coins, and merchants and commoners suffered from them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the capital was circulating large-denomination coins, to the merchants' and people's distress.

sentences.zh: 稷辰上疏請復用制錢，號曰「祖錢」，而大錢改純用鐵鑄，兼行並用。

translations.literal: Jichen memorialized requesting restoration of standard copper cash, styled "ancestral coin," while large coins were to be recast purely in iron, both to circulate together.
translations.idiomatic: Jichen memorialized to restore standard copper cash under the name "ancestral coin," while large coins would be recast in iron only, both denominations to circulate side by side.

sentences.zh: 下部議，格不行。

translations.literal: It was referred to the ministry for deliberation and rejected as infeasible.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries deliberated and rejected the proposal.

sentences.zh: 又以畿輔水患，疏請急賑，從之。

translations.literal: Again, because of flooding in the capital region, he memorialized requesting urgent relief, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: When flooding struck the capital region, he memorialized for urgent relief, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 尋授山東運河道，捻匪入境，於濟寧牛頭河濱築戰牆，北岸六千三百丈，南岸八千六百丈，賴以守禦。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Commissioner of the Shandong Grain Transport Circuit; when Nian bandits entered the province, he built battle walls along the banks of the Niutou River at Jining—6,300 zhang on the north bank and 8,600 zhang on the south—and relied on them for defense.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed commissioner of the Shandong grain-transport circuit. When Nian bandits crossed the border, he built defensive walls along the Niutou River at Jining—6,300 zhang on the north bank and 8,600 on the south—which held the line.

sentences.zh: 以功加鹽運使銜。

translations.literal: For merit he was given the brevet rank of salt transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he received the brevet rank of salt transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 同治六年，引疾歸，尋卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of the Tongzhi reign he cited illness and retired, and soon died.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 6 (1867) he retired on grounds of illness and soon died.

sentences.zh: 稷辰父霈正，官湖南零陵知縣，廉無餘貲。

translations.literal: Jichen's father Peizheng served as magistrate of Lingling in Hunan, was incorruptible, and left no surplus wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Jichen's father Peizheng had been magistrate of Lingling in Hunan—honest and leaving no surplus wealth behind.

sentences.zh: 稷辰事母孝。

translations.literal: Jichen was filial toward his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Jichen was devoted to his mother.

sentences.zh: 為學宗王守仁、劉宗周。

translations.literal: In scholarship he took Wang Shouren and Liu Zongzhou as his masters.
translations.idiomatic: In scholarship he followed Wang Yangming and Liu Zongzhou.

sentences.zh: 罷官後，主餘姚龍山書院、山陰蕺山書院。

translations.literal: After leaving office he headed Longshan Academy in Yuyao and Jishan Academy in Shanyin.
translations.idiomatic: After leaving office he directed Longshan Academy in Yuyao and Jishan Academy in Shanyin.

sentences.zh: 官京朝，請祀總兵葛雲飛本籍；

translations.literal: While serving at court he requested that Brigadier Ge Yunfei be enshrined in his native place;
translations.idiomatic: While at court he petitioned for a shrine to Brigadier Ge Yunfei in Ge's home district;

sentences.zh: 官山東，請修方孝孺祠，並刻正學集：其振勵風教多類此。

translations.literal: while serving in Shandong he requested repair of the shrine to Fang Xiaoru and printing of the Correct Learning Collection: his efforts to revive custom and instruction were largely of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: in Shandong he had Fang Xiaoru's shrine restored and the Correct Learning Collection printed—his efforts to revive moral culture were largely of this kind.

sentences.zh: =尹耕雲= 尹耕雲，字杏農，江蘇桃源人。

translations.literal: =Yin Gengyun= Yin Gengyun, style name Xingnong, was a native of Taoyuan in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Gengyun, whose style name was Xingnong, came from Taoyuan in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 道光三十年進士，授禮部主事，再遷郎中。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of the Daoguang reign he passed the metropolitan examination, was appointed a director in the Ministry of Rites, and was again transferred to bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Daoguang 30 (1850), was appointed a director in the Ministry of Rites, and was later promoted to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 咸豐五年，粵匪犯畿輔，惠親王綿愉為大將軍，僧格林沁參贊軍務，闢耕雲佐幕府，上書論防務，為文宗所知。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianfeng, when Cantonese rebels threatened the capital region, Prince Hui Mianyu served as grand general and Sengge Rinchen assisted in military affairs; Gengyun was recruited to the staff, submitted writings on defense, and came to the notice of Emperor Wenzong.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 5 (1855), when Taiping forces threatened the capital region, Prince Hui Mianyu was appointed grand general with Sengge Rinchen as his deputy; Gengyun joined the staff, wrote on defense, and came to Emperor Xianfeng's attention.

sentences.zh: 八年，授湖廣道監察御史，署戶科給事中。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed investigating censor for the Huguang circuit and acted as supervising secretary of the Revenue Section.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was made investigating censor for the Huguang circuit and served concurrently as acting supervising secretary of the Revenue Section.

sentences.zh: 時方多事，封章月數上。

translations.literal: The times were troubled, and sealed memorials went up several times each month.
translations.idiomatic: In those troubled times he submitted several sealed memorials each month.

sentences.zh: 直隸總督訥爾經額坐貽誤封疆罷，復起。

translations.literal: Zhili governor-general Ne'erjing'e was dismissed for having harmed the frontier, then reappointed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili governor-general Ne'erjing'e had been dismissed for mismanaging the frontier, then was reappointed.

sentences.zh: 耕雲疏言：「訥爾經額之罪，天下共聞共見，未喻其復行起用之故。

translations.literal: Gengyun memorialized: "Ne'erjing'e's guilt is known to all under Heaven, yet the reason for his reappointment is not understood."
translations.idiomatic: Gengyun memorialized: "Ne'erjing'e's failures are known to all, yet no one understands why he has been brought back into office."

sentences.zh: 方今江、淮、楚、豫軍務未靖，秉鉞之臣，星羅棋布，所以奮不顧身，必欲滅此朝食者，固由篤於忠義，亦以國家信賞必罰，有以畏服其心。

translations.literal: Now military affairs in the Jianghuai, Chu, and Yu regions are not yet settled; commanders bearing axes are spread like stars on a board. Those who throw themselves forward resolved to destroy the foe at breakfast do so from deep loyalty, but also because the state's rewards and punishments are trusted and sure, giving means to awe and win their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: With war still raging along the Yangtze, Huai, Chu, and Henan, commanders are posted everywhere. Men who risk all to crush the enemy act from loyalty—but also because they trust the throne to reward merit and punish failure.

sentences.zh: 萬一效尤解體，患何可言？

translations.literal: If others follow suit and the armies dissolve, what calamity could be spoken of?
translations.idiomatic: If others follow his example and the armies lose heart, the harm is beyond words.

sentences.zh: 昔宣宗起用琦善，以陳慶鏞之言而罷。

translations.literal: Formerly Emperor Xuanzong reappointed Qishan, but withdrew the appointment on Chen Qingyong's words.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Daoguang once reappointed Qishan, but withdrew the order after Chen Qingyong remonstrated.

sentences.zh: 伏原紹述心傳，收回成命。

translations.literal: Your servant humbly prays that the emperor continue the transmitted mind-and-heart and recall the completed order.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly beg Your Majesty to follow that worthy precedent and rescind the appointment.

sentences.zh: 」 時粵匪复窺武漢，耕雲疏言：「武漢地踞上游，北窺關陝，南脅湖湘，東撼吳越，西製巴蜀，自古南北用兵，皆出死力爭之。

translations.literal: " At the time Cantonese rebels again eyed Wuhan; Gengyun memorialized: "Wuhan lies at the upper reaches: to the north it overlooks Guanzhong and Shaanxi, to the south it threatens Hunan and Hubei, to the east it shakes Wu and Yue, to the west it controls Ba and Shu—from antiquity, whenever north and south contended in arms, both sides strove with their utmost to hold it."
translations.idiomatic: " When the rebels again threatened Wuhan, Gengyun memorialized that the city commanded the upper Yangtze—overlooking Shaanxi to the north, threatening Hunan and Hubei to the south, menacing Jiangsu and Zhejiang to the east, and holding Sichuan to the west—and that from antiquity every north–south war had been fought to the death for its possession.

sentences.zh: 今賊窺伺楚北，分擾廣濟、黃岡，逼近省城，撫臣胡林翼兵勇數千，眾寡懸絕，江路綿遠，首尾不能兼顧。

translations.literal: Now the rebels watch northern Chu, divide forces to harass Guangji and Huanggang, and press close to the provincial capital; Governor Hu Linyi has only a few thousand troops, the disparity in numbers is extreme, and the river route is long—head and tail cannot both be cared for.
translations.idiomatic: Now the rebels probe northern Hubei, raid Guangji and Huanggang, and press the provincial capital. Governor Hu Linyi has only a few thousand men—far too few—and the long river line cannot be held at both ends.

sentences.zh: 侍郎曾國籓忠勇樸誠，應請授為欽差大臣，率其所部援湖北，較諸他臣事半功倍。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Zeng Guofan is loyal, brave, and plain in sincerity; he should be appointed imperial commissioner to lead his own forces to relieve Hubei—compared with other officials, he would achieve twice the result with half the effort.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Zeng Guofan is loyal, brave, and steadfast; he should be made imperial commissioner to lead his troops to relieve Hubei—no other commander could do half as much.

sentences.zh: 」 粵匪陷定遠，耕雲疏言：「定遠失守，粵、捻新合，必謀北竄，恃山東為之屏蔽。

translations.literal: " When Cantonese rebels took Dingyuan, Gengyun memorialized: "With the fall of Dingyuan, Cantonese and Nian forces have newly joined; they will surely plan to flee north, relying on Shandong as their screen."
translations.idiomatic: " After the rebels took Dingyuan, Gengyun warned that Taiping and Nian forces had joined and would surely drive north, using Shandong as their shield.

sentences.zh: 撫臣崇恩幸其不戕官據城，於賊退後虛報勝仗，內則巧為彌縫，掩一人耳目；

translations.literal: Governor Chong'en was fortunate that they did not kill officials and seize cities; after the rebels withdrew he falsely reported victories, inwardly patching matters over to deceive one man's eyes and ears;
translations.idiomatic: Governor Chong'en was lucky the rebels did not slaughter officials or hold the cities; after they withdrew he filed false victory reports, inwardly papering over the truth to deceive his superiors;

sentences.zh: 外則恣其朘削，竭萬姓脂膏。

translations.literal: outwardly he indulged in squeezing the people dry, draining the fat and marrow of the myriad households.
translations.idiomatic: outwardly he squeezed the people until their wealth was exhausted.

sentences.zh: 惟懇俯念籓籬重地，立予罷斥，簡大員往代。

translations.literal: Your servant humbly begs that the throne consider this vital frontier and immediately dismiss him, selecting a senior official to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to consider this vital frontier post, dismiss him at once, and send a senior replacement.

sentences.zh: 於洪湖​​多募水師，兼飭傅振邦全軍移駐固鎮、靈壁，冀收皖北，以固山東。

translations.literal: Recruit more river troops at Hong Lake, and also order Fu Zhenbang's entire army to move and garrison at Guzhen and Lingbi, hoping to recover northern Anhui and thereby secure Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Recruit more river troops at Hong Lake, and order Fu Zhenbang's entire army to garrison Guzhen and Lingbi, to recover northern Anhui and secure Shandong.

sentences.zh: 」及廬州失守，又​​疏言：「昔人建省安慶，與九江、江寧為犄角，控扼長江。

translations.literal: " When Luzhou also fell, he again memorialized: "Former men established the provincial seat at Anqing, forming a pincer with Jiujiang and Jiangning to control the Yangtze."
translations.idiomatic: " When Luzhou fell as well, he memorialized again that the provincial seat had once been at Anqing, forming a strategic triangle with Jiujiang and Nanjing to control the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 上年徙治廬州，已失形勝，茲並廬州亦不能守。

translations.literal: Last year the seat was moved to Luzhou, already losing strategic advantage; now Luzhou too cannot be held.
translations.idiomatic: Moving the seat to Luzhou last year had already forfeited the strategic advantage; now Luzhou itself cannot be held.

sentences.zh: 胡林翼等自武漢進逼九江，而安徽之賊，或自英、霍走湖北，牽我上游，或自徽、歙擾浙西，窺我腹地。

translations.literal: Hu Linyi and others advance from Wuhan toward Jiujiang, while Anhui rebels may come from Ying and Huo into Hubei to pull at our upper reaches, or from Huizhou and She to harass western Zhejiang and spy on our interior.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Linyi was pressing Jiujiang from Wuhan, while Anhui rebels might strike into Hubei from Yingzhou and Huozhou to tie down our upper Yangtze forces, or raid western Zhejiang from Huizhou and Shexian to threaten the interior.

sentences.zh: 我軍分道救援，罷於奔命。

translations.literal: Our armies divide to rescue on every front and are worn out from running to and fro.
translations.idiomatic: Our armies were split among rescue columns and exhausted from rushing to every alarm.

sentences.zh: 賊有四達之路，我無三面之圍，雖日克一城，何益？

translations.literal: The rebels have roads reaching in four directions; we have no encirclement on three sides—though a city be taken daily, what benefit is there?
translations.idiomatic: The rebels could move in every direction while we could not surround them on three sides—even taking a city a day would accomplish little.

sentences.zh: 撫臣福濟屢挫損威，候補京堂袁甲三素得民心，如以為巡撫，必奮身圖報。

translations.literal: Governor Fuk'ichi has repeatedly suffered defeats and lost prestige; the expectant capital official Yuan Jiasan has long won the people's hearts—if made governor, he would surely throw himself into repaying the favor.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Fuk'ichi had suffered repeated defeats and lost authority; Yuan Jiasan, an expectant capital official, had long enjoyed popular trust—made governor, he would surely repay the appointment with his utmost effort.

sentences.zh: 」 及國籓進師，疏言：「軍興以來，徵調半天下，糜餉數千萬，卒未能掃穴擒渠，則以屢後時而數失機也。

translations.literal: " When Guofan advanced his army, he memorialized: "Since the raising of armies, half the empire has been mobilized and tens of millions in pay squandered, yet in the end the nest was not swept and the ringleader seized—because opportunities were repeatedly missed through lateness."
translations.idiomatic: " When Zeng Guofan took the field, Gengyun memorialized that since the war began half the empire had been mobilized and tens of millions spent, yet the rebel leadership remained at large—because commanders had repeatedly arrived too late and lost their chance.

sentences.zh: 今曾國籓蓄養精銳，所向克捷。

translations.literal: Now Zeng Guofan has nurtured elite troops and wins victory wherever he turns.
translations.idiomatic: Now Zeng Guofan had trained elite troops and was winning wherever he fought.

sentences.zh: 陳玉成、張洛行率悍賊數十萬，齊向潛山、太湖抗拒，眾寡之數，十倍於我，一有疏虞，關係甚重。

translations.literal: Chen Yucheng and Zhang Luoxing lead several hundred thousand fierce rebels together toward Qianshan and Taihu to resist; in numbers of many against few they are ten times our strength—any lapse would bear grave consequences.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yucheng and Zhang Luoxing were leading hundreds of thousands of hardened rebels against Qianshan and Taihu—outnumbering Zeng's force ten to one; any slip would have grave consequences.

sentences.zh: 此時廬、鳳、六合賊勢必單，請飭袁甲三、張國樑刻期搗其巢穴，逼令反顧，或令間道為楚師聲援，亦足褫其狂魄。

translations.literal: At this time rebel strength at Lu, Feng, and Liuhe must surely be thin; your servant begs that Yuan Jiasan and Zhang Guoliang be ordered on a set day to strike their nests, forcing them to look back, or sent by side paths to support the Chu army in sound—this too would suffice to shake their mad spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel strength at Luzhou, Fengyang, and Liuhe must now be thin; I beg that Yuan Jiasan and Zhang Guoliang be ordered to strike their bases on a fixed schedule, forcing them to turn back, or sent by side routes to support Zeng's Hunan army—either move would break their confidence.

sentences.zh: 」別疏劾河道總督庚長，請以甲三兼攝；

translations.literal: " In a separate memorial he impeached Grand Canal director Gengchang and requested that Jiasan hold the post concurrently;
translations.idiomatic: " In a separate memorial he impeached Grand Canal director Gengchang and asked that Yuan Jiasan hold the post concurrently;

sentences.zh: 又論雲南迴匪不宜專意主撫；

translations.literal: he again argued that Yunnan Hui rebels should not be handled with sole reliance on appeasement;
translations.idiomatic: he argued that Yunnan's Hui rebels should not be handled through appeasement alone;

sentences.zh: 又陳京師本計，平糶、採買、周恤、蓄積諸事宜並舉；

translations.literal: he again set forth the capital's fundamental plan, presenting together measures for price stabilization, procurement, relief, and stockpiling;
translations.idiomatic: he laid out the capital's fundamental policies on grain price stabilization, procurement, relief, and reserves;

sentences.zh: 又言錢法積弊：諸疏多見採納。

translations.literal: he again spoke of accumulated abuses in the coinage system: many of these memorials were adopted.
translations.idiomatic: and he exposed long-standing abuses in the coinage—many of his memorials were adopted.

sentences.zh: 英、法合軍犯天津，耕雲專疏者七，會疏者二，力主決戰，上命王大臣集議。

translations.literal: When British and French allied forces attacked Tianjin, Gengyun submitted seven sole memorials and two joint memorials, strongly urging decisive battle; the emperor ordered princes and grand ministers to assemble for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: When British and French forces attacked Tianjin, Gengyun submitted seven individual memorials and two joint ones, urging all-out resistance; the emperor ordered the princes and grand ministers to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 與鄭親王端華等議不合，耕云抗辯痛哭而罷。

translations.literal: His views did not accord with those of Prince Zheng Duanhua and others; Gengyun argued in opposition, wept, and the session adjourned.
translations.idiomatic: He clashed with Prince Zheng Duanhua and others, argued fiercely, wept, and the council broke up.

sentences.zh: 耕云初在禮部，肅順頗重之，乃是為所憎。

translations.literal: Gengyun had earlier been in the Ministry of Rites, where Sushun held him in considerable regard; for this he came to be hated by him.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyun had once served in the Ministry of Rites, where Sushun had valued him highly—for which Sushun now came to hate him.

sentences.zh: 九年，科場獄起，以科道失糾下吏議，而耕雲以充內監試譴獨重，鐫二級調用。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the examination scandal arose; censors and remonstrators were faulted for failure to investigate and referred for punishment, but Gengyun alone received the heavier penalty for serving as examiner for the eunuch examination, was demoted two grades, and transferred.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the examination scandal broke; censors were punished for failing to investigate, but Gengyun alone bore the heavier penalty for having served as examiner for the eunuch examination—demoted two grades and transferred.

sentences.zh: 十年，京師戒嚴，上將幸熱河，耕雲代團防大臣草疏諫阻，復自以書抵肅順，卒不聽。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the capital was placed under martial law; the emperor was about to proceed to Rehe; Gengyun drafted a remonstrance for the defense commissioner and also sent a letter himself to Sushun—the court would not listen in the end.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, with the capital under martial law and the emperor preparing to flee to Rehe, Gengyun drafted a remonstrance for the defense commissioner and wrote personally to Sushun—the court would not listen.

sentences.zh: 侍郎文祥提督九門，遇耕雲東城，相持哭，因為規畫留守諸事。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Wenxiang was in charge of the Nine Gates; he met Gengyun in the eastern city, they clung to each other weeping, and thus planned the affairs of those remaining to hold the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Wenxiang commanded the Nine Gates; he met Gengyun in the eastern city, and they wept in each other's arms while planning the defense of the capital.

sentences.zh: 胡林翼疏薦耕雲胸有權略，請起用。

translations.literal: Hu Linyi memorialized recommending Gengyun as having strategy in his breast and requesting his reappointment.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Linyi memorialized that Gengyun possessed strategic talent and begged for his reappointment.

sentences.zh: 會副都御史毛昶熙治河南團練，疏調從軍。

translations.literal: At the same time Vice Censor-in-chief Mao Changxi was organizing Henan militia and memorialized to transfer Gengyun to serve with the army.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Vice Censor-in-chief Mao Changxi was organizing Henan militia and requested that Gengyun join his staff.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，率部卒五千，從僧格林沁平金樓寨教匪，又偕提督張曜克張岡捻巢，以道員記名，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he led five thousand troops, followed Sengge Rinchen in pacifying the sect rebels at Jinlou Stockade, and together with Regional Commander Zhang Yao took the Nian nest at Zhanggang; he was recorded by name as circuit intendant and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 1 (1862) he led five thousand men with Sengge Rinchen to suppress the sect rebels at Jinlou Stockade, then with Regional Commander Zhang Yao captured the Nian base at Zhanggang; he was registered for circuit intendant and awarded the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 三年，署河陝汝道。

translations.literal: In the third year he acted as intendant of the Henan-Shaanxi-Ru circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he served as acting intendant of the Henan-Shaanxi-Ru circuit.

sentences.zh: 西征軍購糧陝州，市斛小，責屬縣償其不足，凡數百萬斤，耕雲悉請罷之。

translations.literal: The western expedition army purchased grain at Shaanzhou; the market bushel was small, and subordinate counties were charged to make up the shortfall—several million jin in all; Gengyun requested that all such levies be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The western expedition bought grain at Shaanzhou; when the measure fell short, subordinate counties were forced to make up millions of jin; Gengyun had all such exactions cancelled.

sentences.zh: 客軍有不法者，斬以徇。

translations.literal: When guest troops committed outrages, he beheaded them as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: When allied troops broke discipline, he executed offenders as a warning to the rest.

sentences.zh: 境多刀匪，請得節制河、陝兵，饋餉以時，兵咸用命。

translations.literal: The territory had many armed bandits; he requested authority to command Henan and Shaanxi troops, supplied pay on time, and the soldiers all obeyed orders.
translations.idiomatic: The region was rife with armed bandits; granted command over Henan and Shaanxi troops and paying them on time, he brought the soldiers to full obedience.

sentences.zh: 四年，張總愚犯畿輔，耕雲從巡撫李鶴年進軍磁州，建策築長圍斷賊歸路。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Zhang Zongyu invaded the capital region; Gengyun followed Governor Li Henian in advancing on Cizhou and proposed building a long encirclement to cut off the rebels' line of retreat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Zhang Zongyu threatened the capital region; Gengyun marched with Governor Li Henian to Cizhou and proposed a long encirclement to cut off the rebels' retreat.

sentences.zh: 兩署糧儲鹽法道，佐治善後事，濬惠濟河，塞河決，敘勞加布政使銜。

translations.literal: Twice he acted as intendant of grain storage and salt administration, assisting in postwar settlement, dredging the Huiji River, blocking river breaches, and for recorded merit received the brevet rank of provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He twice acted as intendant of grain and salt affairs, helped with postwar recovery, dredged the Huiji River and sealed breaches, and for his service received the brevet rank of provincial administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十三年，補河陝汝道。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was confirmed as intendant of the Henan-Shaanxi-Ru circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was confirmed in the Henan-Shaanxi-Ru intendant post.

sentences.zh: 河、陝徭役重，亞於常賦，耕雲立定制，嚴稽覈，民困稍甦。

translations.literal: Corvée labor in Henan and Shaanxi was heavy, second only to regular tax; Gengyun established fixed regulations and enforced strict audit, and the people's distress was somewhat relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée in Henan and Shaanxi was nearly as heavy as regular tax; Gengyun fixed the regulations and enforced strict audits, and the people's burden eased somewhat.

sentences.zh: 光緒三年，大旱，條上救荒七事，未及行，卒於官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Guangxu there was great drought; he itemized seven measures for famine relief, but before they could be enacted he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 3 (1877), during a severe drought, he submitted seven famine-relief measures; before they could be carried out, he died in office.

sentences.zh: 耕雲在言路著直聲，出任監司，巡撫張之萬、李鶴年皆倚重之，軍事多所贊畫。

translations.literal: Gengyun won renown for blunt speaking on the remonstrance track; when he went out as surveillance commissioner, governors Zhang Zhiwan and Li Henian both relied on him, and he contributed much to military planning.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyun was famed for blunt memorials; as a provincial official, governors Zhang Zhiwan and Li Henian relied on him heavily for military planning.

sentences.zh: 卒後，巡撫李慶翱以災荒被劾，牽及冒領兵餉事，辭連耕雲，後終得白云。

translations.literal: After his death, Governor Li Qing'ao was impeached over famine relief and implicated in falsely claiming military pay; testimony implicated Gengyun, but in the end he was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: After his death, Governor Li Qing'ao was impeached over famine relief and implicated in false claims on military pay that dragged in Gengyun's name; Gengyun was eventually cleared.

sentences.zh: =王拯= 王拯，初名錫振，字定甫，廣西馬平人。

translations.literal: =Wang Zheng= Wang Zheng, original name Xizhen, style name Dingfu, was a native of Maping in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zheng, originally named Xizhen and styled Dingfu, came from Maping in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 道光二十一年進士，授戶部主事，充軍機章京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Daoguang he passed the metropolitan examination, was appointed a director in the Ministry of Revenue, and served as a clerk on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Daoguang 21 (1841), was appointed a director in the Ministry of Revenue, and served as a Grand Council clerk.

sentences.zh: 大學士賽尚阿視師廣西，以拯從，拯感時多難，慷慨思有所建白。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Saishanga took command in Guangxi and took Zheng with him; Zheng, moved by the troubles of the times, wished ardently to offer some constructive proposal.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Secretary Saishanga took command in Guangxi, Zheng accompanied him; stirred by the nation's troubles, Zheng was eager to offer constructive counsel.

sentences.zh: 咸豐間，自郎中累遷大理寺少卿。

translations.literal: During the Xianfeng reign he rose from bureau director through successive promotions to vice minister of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng era he rose from bureau director to vice minister of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，降捻宋景詩由陝西還擾直隸、山東，拯奏言：「景詩岡屯磚圩，儼然嵎固，自陝逸回，其黨不過數百。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi, the surrendered Nian Song Jingshi returned from Shaanxi to harass Zhili and Shandong; Zheng memorialized: "Jingshi's Gangtun brick stockade stands like a cornered beast's lair; since his escape from Shaanxi his band numbers only a few hundred."
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 2 (1863), the surrendered Nian leader Song Jingshi fled Shaanxi to raid Zhili and Shandong; Zheng memorialized that Jingshi's fortified stockade at Gangtun was a rebel stronghold, and that since his escape from Shaanxi his following numbered only a few hundred.

sentences.zh: 崇厚等一再養癰，裹脅逾萬。

translations.literal: Chonghou and others repeatedly nursed the sore, and through coercion the force exceeded ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Chonghou and others repeatedly indulged the threat until, through coercion, his force swelled past ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 近复於昌邑、莘、聊城、臨清四州縣，令村莊將所獲麥與佃戶平分，運送岡屯，是其名為降伏，心跡轉益兇悖。

translations.literal: Recently again in the four prefectures and counties of Changyi, Shen, Liaocheng, and Linqing he ordered villages to divide harvested wheat with tenant farmers and transport it to Gangtun—though in name he had submitted, in mind and deed he grew ever more fierce and rebellious.
translations.idiomatic: Recently he ordered villages in Changyi, Shen, Liaocheng, and Linqing to split the wheat harvest with tenants and send the grain to Gangtun—though nominally surrendered, his actions grew ever more defiant.

sentences.zh: 請密敕直隸督臣劉長佑計調來營，暴其罪而誅之。

translations.literal: Your servant begs a secret order to Zhili governor Liu Changyou to plan summoning him to camp, expose his crimes, and execute him.
translations.idiomatic: I beg a secret order to Zhili governor Liu Changyou to lure him to camp, expose his crimes, and execute him.

sentences.zh: 若抗違不至，直隸官軍猶能越境進剿。

translations.literal: If he resists and refuses to come, Zhili government troops can still cross the border to pursue and suppress.
translations.idiomatic: If he refuses, Zhili troops can still cross the border to attack him.

sentences.zh: 景詩既除，如楊蓬嶺、程順書等首惡，皆可駢誅，以除巨憝，以安畿輔。

translations.literal: Once Jingshi is removed, ringleaders such as Yang Pengling and Cheng Shunshu can all be executed together, to eliminate the great scourge and secure the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Once Jingshi is eliminated, ringleaders such as Yang Pengling and Cheng Shunshu can be executed together, removing the chief threat and securing the capital region.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，未行。

translations.literal: "When the memorial entered, it was not enacted.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was received but not acted upon.

sentences.zh: 其後景詩卒以叛誅。

translations.literal: Afterward Jingshi was in the end executed for rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Jingshi was eventually executed for rebellion.

sentences.zh: 軍事未定，曾國籓議於廣東籌餉，勞崇光創辦釐金，諸弊叢起。

translations.literal: With military affairs unsettled, Zeng Guofan proposed raising funds in Guangdong; Lao Chongguang inaugurated the lijin tax, and abuses clustered thick.
translations.idiomatic: While the war continued, Zeng Guofan proposed raising funds in Guangdong; Lao Chongguang introduced the lijin transit tax, and abuses multiplied.

sentences.zh: 拯疏言：「兩粵為肇亂之區，岑溪、容縣，數載皆為賊踞。

translations.literal: Zheng memorialized: "The two Guang provinces are the region where rebellion began; Cenxi and Rongxian have for years been held by rebels."
translations.idiomatic: Zheng memorialized that the two Guang provinces were where the rebellion had begun, and that Cenxi and Rongxian had been held by rebels for years.

sentences.zh: 信宜陳金缸尤為巨憝，群賊相為一氣，滋蔓難圖。

translations.literal: Chen Jingang of Xinyi is especially the great scourge; the bandits breathe as one force, spreading in ways hard to plot against.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Jingang of Xinyi was the chief scourge; the rebel bands acted as one, spreading in ways difficult to suppress.

sentences.zh: 勞崇光舉辦釐金，率令紳商包充墊繳，燃眉剜肉，事何可常？

translations.literal: Lao Chongguang undertook the lijin, generally ordering gentry and merchants to contract and advance payment—cutting flesh to relieve burning brows; how can such a thing last?
translations.idiomatic: Lao Chongguang ran the lijin by forcing gentry and merchants to contract and advance payments—a desperate expedient that could not endure.

sentences.zh: 及崇光去任，徵收減少。

translations.literal: When Chongguang left his post, collection decreased.
translations.idiomatic: After Chongguang left office, collections fell sharply.

sentences.zh: 近乃有釐務委員，或為眾所毆傷，或為民間枷號，雖民情頑獷，而官吏惡劣亦可概見。

translations.literal: Recently lijin commissioners have been beaten by crowds or pilloried by the people; though popular temper is stubborn and violent, the vileness of officials can also be seen in general.
translations.idiomatic: Recently lijin commissioners had been beaten by mobs or pilloried by villagers; though the people were unruly, the conduct of officials was plainly abominable.

sentences.zh: 以積年久亂之地，有負嵎圜視之賊，當一切利孔、百方搜剔之時，臣竊恐利未十而害已百。

translations.literal: In a land of chronic disorder, with rebels crouched like beasts glaring round, at a time when every source of profit is hunted by a hundred methods, your servant fears profit may not reach ten parts while harm already reaches a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In a land long torn by rebellion, with cornered rebels still at large, and every source of revenue squeezed by a hundred devices, I fear the profit will be trifling while the harm will be immense.

sentences.zh: 萬一兩粵复糜爛，更不知何所措手足，豈惟釐金不能辦而已？

translations.literal: If by chance the two Guang provinces again dissolve in chaos, one would not know where to set hand or foot—how could lijin alone be collected?
translations.idiomatic: If the two Guang provinces collapsed into chaos again, the court would not know which way to turn—and lijin would be the least of its worries.

sentences.zh: 」因薦廣東道員唐啟廕、兩淮運使郭嵩燾、浙江運使成孫詒。

translations.literal: " He therefore recommended Guangdong circuit intendant Tang Qizhao, Liang-Huai grain transport commissioner Guo Songtao, and Zhejiang grain transport commissioner Cheng Sunyi.
translations.idiomatic: He recommended Guangdong circuit intendant Tang Qizhao, Liang-Huai grain transport commissioner Guo Songtao, and Zhejiang grain transport commissioner Cheng Sunyi.

sentences.zh: 旋用嵩燾督廣東釐金，自拯疏發之也。

translations.literal: Soon Songtao was used to supervise Guangdong lijin—this originated from Zheng's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Songtao was soon appointed to supervise Guangdong lijin on the strength of Zheng's memorial.

sentences.zh: 三年，遷太常寺卿，署左副都御史。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and acted as left vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was made minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and acting left vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 疏論：「總理各國事務大臣侍郎崇綸、恆祺、董恂、薛煥委瑣齷齪，通國皆知，竊恐外邦輕侮，以為中朝卿貳之班，大都不過如若曹等，未免為中朝恥辱。

translations.literal: He memorialized in argument: "The vice ministers Chonglun, Hengqi, Dong Xun, and Xue Huan of the Yamen for Managing the Affairs of All Nations are petty and sordid—the whole country knows it; your servant fears foreign states will hold them in contempt, thinking that among the court's vice-ministerial ranks most are no better than such men, which cannot but shame the dynasty."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that Vice Ministers Chonglun, Hengqi, Dong Xun, and Xue Huan of the Foreign Affairs Yamen were petty and contemptible—known to all—and that foreign powers would despise the court if such men represented its senior ranks.

sentences.zh: 就令人材難得，或於總理衙門位置為宜，上應量為裁抑，或處以散職，或畀以虛銜，庶外邦服我旌別之嚴。

translations.literal: Even if talent is hard to obtain and placement in the Foreign Affairs Yamen may be suitable, the throne should measure and restrain them, or assign nominal posts, or grant empty titles, so that foreign states may respect our strict distinctions of rank.
translations.idiomatic: Even if talent was scarce and the yamen needed staff, the throne should restrain such men, assign them nominal posts or empty titles, so foreign powers would respect the court's standards of rank.

sentences.zh: 四方聞之，亦釋然於朝廷宥納群倫、羈縻彼族之意。

translations.literal: When the four quarters hear of it, they will also be reassured of the court's intent to embrace all classes and keep those peoples on leading reins.
translations.idiomatic: The empire would then understand the court's intent to embrace all subjects while keeping foreign powers on a tight rein.

sentences.zh: 」 尋遷通政使，仍署左副都御史。

translations.literal: " Soon he was transferred to transmission commissioner, still acting as left vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made transmission commissioner while continuing as acting left vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「近日蘇、杭迭克，直、東肅清。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Recently Suzhou and Hangzhou have been taken in succession, and Zhili and Shandong cleared."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that Suzhou and Hangzhou had recently fallen in succession and that Zhili and Shandong had been cleared.

sentences.zh: 臣觀從來將興之業，垂成之功，未有不矢以小心，而始能底定者。

translations.literal: Your servant observes that enterprises about to rise and achievements near completion have never failed to be pursued with utmost caution before they could be brought to settlement.
translations.idiomatic: I observe that enterprises nearing success have never been completed without the utmost caution.

sentences.zh: 金陵賊窟雖計於三四月間可拔，而丹陽與常州犄角，百戰悍賊如李秀成等，麇集死守。

translations.literal: Though the rebel nest at Jinling is counted on for capture within three or four months, Danyang and Changzhou form a pincer, and battle-hardened fierce rebels such as Li Xiucheng gather in dense masses to defend to the death.
translations.idiomatic: Though Nanjing was expected to fall within three or four months, Danyang and Changzhou formed a defensive triangle, and hardened rebels such as Li Xiucheng massed for a last stand.

sentences.zh: 杭、嘉既克，餘黨歸併湖州。

translations.literal: Hang and Jia having been taken, the remnant bands merged at Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: With Hangzhou and Jiaxing taken, the remaining rebels converged on Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 其自皖南竄越江西之賊，蔓延玉山、鉛山、金谿、建昌二三百里，眾號八九萬，並有闌入福建境者。

translations.literal: Those who fled south from Anhui into Jiangxi spread over two or three hundred li through Yushan, Qianshan, Jinxi, and Jianchang, numbering by report eighty or ninety thousand, and some even intruded into Fujian territory.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels fleeing south from Anhui into Jiangxi spread over two or three hundred li through Yushan, Qianshan, Jinxi, and Jianchang—reportedly eighty or ninety thousand strong—and some even crossed into Fujian.

sentences.zh: 又聞李世賢自率巨股由淳安、遂安接踵而至，曾國籓、左宗棠等用兵日久，前此屢陳不亟求功旦夕，同一老謀深計，獨於皖、浙毗境豫作防維之策，則國籓意在徽、寧各飭所部分防，宗棠以為不若並力取廣德扼賊竄路。

translations.literal: It is also heard that Li Shixian personally leads a great band approaching in succession from Chun'an and Suian; Zeng Guofan and Zuo Zongtang have waged war for long—before this they repeatedly stated that success should not be rushed overnight, sharing the same deep counsel—yet on the Anhui-Zhejiang border alone they differed on preventive measures: Guofan intended separate defense by the Huizhou and Ningguo commands, while Zongtang held it better to combine forces and take Guangde to choke the rebels' escape route.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shixian was said to be leading a large force through Chun'an and Suian. Zeng Guofan and Zuo Zongtang, veteran commanders who had long urged patience, disagreed on the Anhui-Zhejiang border: Zeng wanted separate defenses for Huizhou and Ningguo, while Zuo preferred concentrating forces to seize Guangde and block the rebels' escape.

sentences.zh: 兩議未及定，賊已由皖竄贛。

translations.literal: Before the two plans could be settled, the rebels had already fled from Anhui into Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Before the two plans could be settled, the rebels had already fled from Anhui into Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 賊又草竊已久，人數太眾，勢多不能聚殲而弗使一賊他遁。

translations.literal: The rebels have long been bandits in the grass; their numbers are too great, and the tendency is often inability to annihilate them in a mass while preventing a single rebel from escaping elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Long accustomed to guerrilla warfare, the rebels were too numerous to annihilate in one blow while preventing any from escaping.

sentences.zh: 臣則以此賊人多勢劇，一意奔突，前股未痛剿，後股又踵接。

translations.literal: Your servant holds that these rebels are numerous and their momentum fierce, bent solely on rushing forward—before the forward band is bitterly suppressed, the rear band follows in succession.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that the rebels were numerous and fierce, driving forward relentlessly—before one column was crushed, another followed close behind.

sentences.zh: 萬一深入江西腹地，燼餘复熾，又至燎原。

translations.literal: If by chance they penetrate deep into Jiangxi's interior, embers may blaze anew and again reach prairie-burning scale.
translations.idiomatic: If they penetrated deep into Jiangxi, the embers could blaze again across the land.

sentences.zh: 且由贛逾閩，可以直走汀、潮，為數年來竄匪熟路。

translations.literal: Moreover, from Jiangxi crossing Fujian they can go straight to Ting and Chao—an old familiar route of fleeing rebels for several years.
translations.idiomatic: From Jiangxi they could cross into Fujian and march straight to Tingzhou and Chaozhou—a well-worn rebel escape route for years.

sentences.zh: 黃文金由此而來，石達開由此而去，前事可為深警。

translations.literal: Huang Wenjin came by this route, Shi Dakai went by this route—the past should serve as a deep warning.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Wenjin had come this way, Shi Dakai had gone this way—the precedent was a grave warning.

sentences.zh: 疊蒙諭旨，曾國籓、左宗棠、李鴻章、沈葆楨及閩、粵各督撫諄諄戒備。

translations.literal: Repeatedly receiving imperial instructions, Zeng Guofan, Zuo Zongtang, Li Hongzhang, Shen Baozhen, and the governors of Fujian and Guangdong were earnestly warned to prepare.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial orders repeatedly warned Zeng Guofan, Zuo Zongtang, Li Hongzhang, Shen Baozhen, and the Fujian and Guangdong governors to prepare.

sentences.zh: 當此大功將竟，惟當效力一心，互籌戰守，務將分竄諸賊，前截後追，必使所至創夷，日就衰殘零落，不得喙息，以成巨患。

translations.literal: At this time when great merit is near completion, all should serve with one heart, consult on attack and defense, strive to cut off the scattered fleeing rebels fore and aft, and ensure that wherever they go they are wounded and broken, daily declining and falling apart, unable to draw breath, lest a great calamity be completed.
translations.idiomatic: With final victory near, all must act as one, coordinate attack and defense, cut off fleeing bands fore and aft, and break them wherever they appear—daily weakening them until they cannot regroup, lest a great threat revive.

sentences.zh: 臣尤有請者，皖、浙諸軍與賊相持不為不久，所需餉項，國籓、宗棠等各於江、楚等省自為籌畫。

translations.literal: Your servant has a further request: the Anhui and Zhejiang armies have contended with rebels not a short time; the pay they require Guofan, Zongtang, and others each plan for themselves in Jiangsu, Huguang, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: I further urge that the Anhui and Zhejiang armies, long at war, depend on pay that Zeng and Zuo each raise from Jiangsu, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 國籓奏於江省設立總台，以一省捐釐之數，為皖軍十萬養命之源。

translations.literal: Guofan memorialized establishing a general office in Jiangsu province, using that province's donated lijin totals as the source sustaining one hundred thousand Anhui troops.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng had established a central lijin office in Jiangsu, using the province's levies to sustain his hundred-thousand-man Anhui army.

sentences.zh: 浙軍固不能分撥，即國籓所部月餉，傳聞亦祗放數成，不得已而籌及廣東釐捐，乃又不能遽辦。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang army certainly cannot share out; even the monthly pay of Guofan's own command, it is reported, is issued only in part; compelled by necessity he turned to Guangdong lijin levies, yet these too cannot be promptly raised.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang army could not share its funds; even Zeng's monthly pay was reportedly issued only in part; forced to turn to Guangdong lijin, he could not raise it promptly.

sentences.zh: 夫民之不能見遠而各為其私者，情也。

translations.literal: That the people cannot see far and each pursues private interest is human feeling.
translations.idiomatic: It is human nature that people cannot see far ahead and each pursues private interest.

sentences.zh: 廣東有之，江西豈獨不然？

translations.literal: Guangdong has this—how could Jiangxi alone be otherwise?
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong behaves thus—would Jiangxi be any different?

sentences.zh: 日前沈葆楨奏請將江西茶稅、牙釐等款歸本省任收，旋用部議允留其半，在國籓等斷不至觖望。

translations.literal: Recently Shen Baozhen memorialized requesting that Jiangxi tea tax, broker lijin, and other items be collected by the province itself; soon the ministry deliberation allowed it to retain half—Guofan and others would certainly not be disappointed.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen had recently asked that Jiangxi tea tax and broker lijin be collected locally; the ministries allowed half to remain in the province—Zeng and others would surely not object.

sentences.zh: 惟軍前將卒，當枕戈喋血切望成功之時，忽聞軍餉來源將減，眾心或生疑懼，何以得飽騰而資鼓舞？

translations.literal: Only the generals and soldiers at the front, at a time when they sleep on weapons and spill blood in keen hope of success, if they suddenly hear that the source of military pay will shrink, the mass mind may breed doubt and fear—how can they be fed full and roused to encouragement?
translations.idiomatic: But troops at the front, fighting in keen hope of victory, hearing that pay would shrink might lose heart—how could they fight on full stomachs and high spirits?

sentences.zh: 擬請飭贛、皖、楚、粵各疆臣，值此事機至緊，無論如何變通為難，總當殫竭血誠，同心共濟。

translations.literal: Your servant proposes ordering the frontier officials of Jiangxi, Anhui, Huguang, and Guangdong that, as this juncture is most urgent, however difficult adaptation may be, they should exhaust loyal sincerity and aid one another with one heart.
translations.idiomatic: I propose ordering the governors of Jiangxi, Anhui, Huguang, and Guangdong that, at this critical juncture, however difficult the arrangements, they must give their utmost and act in concert.

sentences.zh: 甘肅回氛未戢，中州餘捻尚存，汝南陳大喜等竄逸湖北，自隨、棗逼襄、樊；

translations.literal: Gansu Hui unrest is not yet quelled, remnant Nian in the central plains still survive, Chen Daxi of Runan and others flee into Hubei, from Suizhou and Zaoyang pressing Xiangyang and Fancheng;
translations.idiomatic: Gansu's Hui rebellion was not yet suppressed, Nian remnants lingered in the central plains, Chen Daxi of Runan had fled into Hubei from Suizhou and Zaoyang toward Xiangyang and Fancheng;

sentences.zh: 張總愚自南台山中出竄內、淅，時虞合併；

translations.literal: Zhang Zongyu emerges from the Nan Tai Mountains to flee into Henan and Zhejiang, at times feared to merge with them;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zongyu had emerged from the Nan Tai Mountains into Henan and Zhejiang, at times feared to join them;

sentences.zh: 漢中之賊，全竄寧、陝、商州一路，聞將會齊襄、樊回援金陵，誠亦未可輕忽。

translations.literal: rebels from Hanzhong have all fled along the Ning, Shaan, and Shangzhou route; it is heard they will join at Xiangyang and Fancheng to return and relieve Jinling—this too truly cannot be lightly neglected.
translations.idiomatic: Hanzhong rebels had fled through Ningxia, Shaanxi, and Shangzhou, reportedly to join forces at Xiangyang and Fancheng to relieve Nanjing—a threat not to be taken lightly.

sentences.zh: 目前陝省軍務，政出多門，李雲麟追賊商於，忽卷旆而西，其在興安，未能遏賊竄逸，其在漢陰，遇賊避匿，縱勇淫掠，宜量加裁抑。

translations.literal: At present Shaanxi military affairs have policy issuing from many gates; Li Yunlin pursued rebels in Shangyu, then suddenly furled banners and went west; at Xing'an he failed to check rebel flight, at Hanyin he met rebels and hid, indulging braves in licentious plunder—he should be measured and restrained.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi's military affairs were fragmented; Li Yunlin pursued rebels in Shangyu then suddenly marched west—in Xing'an he failed to stop rebel flight, in Hanyin he hid from the enemy and let his troops plunder—he should be restrained.

sentences.zh: 劉蓉素嘗學問，懷負非常，漢中之賊，本所專辦，而竄擾四出，尤當誓志盪除，方為不負。

translations.literal: Liu Rong has long pursued learning and bears extraordinary capacity; the Hanzhong rebels were originally his special charge, yet they flee and harass on four sides—he especially should vow in will to sweep them away, lest he fail his trust.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Rong was a scholar of unusual capacity charged with Hanzhong—yet rebels were spreading in every direction; he must vow to eliminate them or fail his charge.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿聲望最優，眾口爭傳為第一名將，乃近日聲望漸損，宜申聖諭訓飭。

translations.literal: Duolong'a's renown is highest; all mouths contend he is the foremost general—yet recently his prestige has gradually declined; imperial instruction for admonition should be conveyed.
translations.idiomatic: Duolong'a enjoyed the highest reputation—hailed as the foremost general—but his prestige had lately declined; imperial admonition was in order.

sentences.zh: 雷正綰所向克捷，諒足當一面之寄，顧全甘官吏，未有一二正人支持其間。

translations.literal: Lei Zhengwan wins victory wherever he turns and surely suffices for independent command, yet throughout Gansu officials there are not one or two upright men to support him.
translations.idiomatic: Lei Zhengwan won wherever he fought and was fit for independent command, yet among Gansu officials not one or two upright men supported him.

sentences.zh: 現聞蘭州與慶陽隔絕，恩麟權督印，不過使令便闢之材，識見陋劣；

translations.literal: It is now heard that Lanzhou and Qingyang are cut off; Enlin holds the governor's seal in proxy—no more than talent for convenient orders, his insight coarse and inferior;
translations.idiomatic: Lanzhou and Qingyang were now cut off; Enlin held the governor's seal in proxy—a man fit only for petty orders, of coarse judgment;

sentences.zh: 熙麟坐守慶陽、寧夏一區，又為慶昀種種紕繆所誤。

translations.literal: Xilin sits guarding the Qingyang and Ningxia region, and is again misled by Qingyun's various blunders.
translations.idiomatic: Xilin held Qingyang and Ningxia but was misled by Qingyun's repeated blunders.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為亟宜遴簡公正有為之大臣，鎮撫整飭。

translations.literal: Your servant in folly holds that a just and capable grand minister should urgently be selected to pacify and rectify the region.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that an upright and capable senior minister should urgently be sent to pacify and reorganize the region.

sentences.zh: 今之天下，何易遽言率土奠安，而南北軍務漸定，西事再能就緒，亦即為大致之澄清。

translations.literal: Today's realm—how easily can one hastily say that all within the four seas is settled? Yet as north and south military affairs gradually settle, if western affairs can again be brought to order, that will also mean general clarification.
translations.idiomatic: The empire is far from settled, yet as north and south gradually calm, if the west can be brought to order, the realm will approach general peace.

sentences.zh: 朝廷者天下之本，宮府清明嚴肅，與疆場奮迅振拔之氣，相感而自通。

translations.literal: The court is the root of the realm; when palace and offices are clear and stern, and the frontier's spirit of striving vigor resonates, they respond to each other of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The court is the root of the realm—when the palace is clear and strict, it resonates with the vigor of the frontiers and the two reinforce each other.

sentences.zh: 天下大勢日轉，而亦正多難鉅之事，或遽以為時局清明，事機暢遂，若已治已安者然。

translations.literal: The great trend of the realm turns daily, yet there are also many difficult and weighty matters; some may hastily think the times clear, affairs smooth, as if already governed and already secure.
translations.idiomatic: The realm's situation turns daily, yet grave difficulties remain; some may hastily think the times clear and affairs smooth, as if order were already won.

sentences.zh: 人情大抵喜新狃常，畏難而務獲，獨有當幾至誠君子，為能深察而切戒之。

translations.literal: Human feeling mostly delights in the new and clings to the old, fears difficulty and seeks quick gain—only the utterly sincere gentleman at the critical juncture can deeply observe and earnestly warn against this.
translations.idiomatic: People delight in novelty yet cling to routine, fear hardship and seek quick gain—only the utterly sincere can see this deeply and warn against it.

sentences.zh: 昔諸葛亮為三代下一人，史獨稱之以謹慎。

translations.literal: Formerly Zhuge Liang was the one man below the Three Dynasties, and history alone praises him for caution.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuge Liang was the greatest man since the Three Dynasties, and history praises him above all for caution.

sentences.zh: 硃子進戒宋孝宗曰：​​'使宴安酖毒之害，日滋而日長；

translations.literal: Master Zhu admonished Emperor Xiaozong of Song: 'Let the harm of ease and poisoned comfort daily grow and lengthen;
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xi admonished Emperor Xiaozong of Song: 'Let the harm of ease and complacency grow day by day;

sentences.zh: 將臥薪嘗膽之志，日遠而日忘。

translations.literal: the will to sleep on brushwood and taste gall will daily recede and daily be forgotten.'
translations.idiomatic: the resolve to endure hardship for revenge will daily fade and be forgotten.'

sentences.zh: '臣不勝私憂過計，冒昧瀝陳。

translations.literal: 'Your servant cannot overcome private worry and excessive concern, and ventures to pour forth this statement.
translations.idiomatic: I cannot restrain my private anxiety and venture this frank statement.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，報聞。

translations.literal: "When the memorial entered, acknowledgment was returned.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was received and acknowledged.

sentences.zh: 尋告歸，卒。

translations.literal: Soon he requested leave to return home and died.
translations.idiomatic: He soon retired and died.

sentences.zh: =穆緝香阿= 穆緝香阿，字居南，滿洲鑲紅旗人。

translations.literal: =Mu Jixianga= Mu Jixianga, style name Junan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Jixianga, whose style name was Junan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 由工部主事再遷郎中。

translations.literal: From director in the Ministry of Works he was again transferred to bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from director in the Ministry of Works to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 同治四年，授山東道監察御史。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi he was appointed investigating censor for the Shandong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 4 (1865) he was made investigating censor for the Shandong circuit.

sentences.zh: 疏請慎擇宦寺，略言：「皇上沖齡御極，聖學日新，知識日開，左右侍從之輩，宜豫加慎選，勿使將來蠱惑聖聰。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting careful selection of eunuchs, stating in summary: "The emperor ascended the throne at a tender age; sacred learning renews daily and knowledge opens daily—those who attend at left and right should be chosen with forethought, lest they later bewitch and confuse the sacred ear."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized for careful selection of eunuchs: "The emperor ascended the throne as a child; his learning and understanding grow daily—those who attend him must be chosen with care, lest they later mislead his judgment."

sentences.zh: 溯自漢末及前明，朝政之失，半由宦寺。

translations.literal: Tracing back from the end of Han and the former Ming, half the failures of court governance arose from eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: From the end of Han through the Ming, half the court's failures arose from eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 蓋宦寺出身之始，每以小忠小信，便捷逢迎，無非售其固寵邀恩之計。

translations.literal: For at the beginning of a eunuch's rise he always shows small loyalty and small trustworthiness, quick compliance and fawning—nothing but a scheme to sell his plan to secure favor and court grace.
translations.idiomatic: At first eunuchs win favor through petty loyalty, quick compliance, and flattery—all to secure lasting patronage.

sentences.zh: 及黨與已成，則驕肆專橫，而箝制其上，雖英明之主，竟有百計不能除之者。

translations.literal: When their faction is formed, they grow arrogant and domineering and clamp down on those above—even an enlightened sovereign may have a hundred schemes yet cannot remove them.
translations.idiomatic: Once their faction is formed, they grow arrogant and dominate their superiors—even an enlightened sovereign may find them impossible to remove.

sentences.zh: 當時臣民，切齒痛恨，終歸無可如何。

translations.literal: Officials and people of the time gnashed teeth in hatred, yet in the end could do nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and people gnashed their teeth in hatred, yet could do nothing.

sentences.zh: 我朝列聖相承，遠邁前代，不但不准此輩干預政事，雖應對進退間亦不假以辭色，使無由讒諂面諛，浸潤膚受。

translations.literal: Our dynasty's successive sages inherited one from another, far surpassing former ages—not only forbidding this sort to intervene in government affairs, but even in answering and advancing and retreating not lending them words or countenance, so they had no means for slander, flattery to the face, or gradual soaking of the skin.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty's successive emperors far surpassed former ages—not only barring eunuchs from government, but refusing even courteous words in daily encounters, leaving no opening for slander or flattery.

sentences.zh: 是以二百餘年，從不為患。

translations.literal: Thus for more than two hundred years they have never been a scourge.
translations.idiomatic: Thus for more than two hundred years they had never been a scourge.

sentences.zh: 雖然如此嚴防，尚有防不勝防之慮。

translations.literal: Though guarded so strictly, there is still the worry that guard cannot overcome guard.
translations.idiomatic: Yet even with such strict precautions, there remained the fear that guard could not fully prevail.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶癸酉之變，猶有通賊者，是此輩反覆已有明徵也。

translations.literal: In the Jiaqing guiyou incident there were still those who communicated with rebels—clear proof that this sort's treachery was already manifest.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiaqing guiyou incident some eunuchs had communicated with rebels—clear proof of their treachery.

sentences.zh: 今皇太后垂簾聽政，洞悉其弊，杜漸防微，有鑑於前，不使宵小蒙蔽。

translations.literal: Now the empress dowager holds the curtain and hears government, penetrating their abuses, stopping the gradual and guarding the minute, taking warning from the past, not allowing petty men to blind and cover.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager now held the curtain audience, understood these abuses, guarded against gradual encroachment, learned from the past, and would not let petty men deceive the throne.

sentences.zh: 所以知人善任，朝政肅清。

translations.literal: Therefore she knows men and employs them well, and court governance is stern and clear.
translations.idiomatic: She knew men and employed them well, and court governance was clear and strict.

sentences.zh: 即數年後皇上親政，亦斷不致寵任此輩，貽誤事機，何待臣下鰓鰓過慮？

translations.literal: Even when the emperor personally governs in several years, he will certainly not favor and employ this sort to the harm of affairs—why should subordinate officials gill-gill with excessive worry?
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor assumes personal rule in a few years, he will surely not favor such men to the court's harm—why should officials fret excessively?

sentences.zh: 然獻曝之忱，有不能已者。

translations.literal: Yet the feeling of offering sun-drying cannot be stilled.
translations.idiomatic: Yet my earnest desire to offer counsel could not be stilled.

sentences.zh: 當此之時，正聖學擴充之際，雖臣工皆能盡心輔佐，而宦寺尤宜加意斟酌。

translations.literal: At this time, when sacred learning is expanding, though civil officials can all assist with full heart, eunuchs especially should receive added deliberate choice.
translations.idiomatic: At this time of expanding imperial learning, though officials can assist with full devotion, eunuchs especially merit careful selection.

sentences.zh: 臣以為宦寺之設，無非效奔走、供指使而已，萬不可使年輕敏捷之人，常侍左右。

translations.literal: Your servant holds that eunuchs are established for nothing but running errands and receiving orders—young and quick men must never constantly attend at left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs exist only to run errands and take orders—young and quick-witted men must never attend the emperor constantly.

sentences.zh: 請皇太后選忠正老成者為我皇上朝夕侍從，庶將來親政，必不致受其欺矇蠱惑，而無疆之聖德，基於此矣！

translations.literal: Your servant begs the empress dowager to select the loyal, upright, and mature to attend our emperor morning and evening, so that when he later governs in person he will surely not suffer their deception, blinding, and bewitching—and the boundless sacred virtue will have its foundation here!
translations.idiomatic: I beg the empress dowager to choose loyal and mature attendants for the emperor day and night, so that when he assumes personal rule he will not be deceived or misled—and his boundless virtue will rest on this foundation!

sentences.zh: 」 五年，疏論大學士曾國籓督師討捻，日久無功，請量加譴責。

translations.literal: " In the fifth year he memorialized arguing that Grand Secretary Zeng Guofan, commanding armies against the Nian, had long achieved no merit and should receive measured censure.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he memorialized that Grand Secretary Zeng Guofan, commanding the Nian campaign, had achieved nothing after a long campaign and should be censured.

sentences.zh: 上以國籓迭疏引咎，特命回任專辦餉糈，雖未蕆全功，非貽誤軍情者可比，斥所奏過當，置不議。

translations.literal: The emperor held that Guofan had repeatedly memorialized accepting blame and was specially ordered back to his post to handle pay and provisions exclusively; though he had not completed full merit, he was not comparable to one who harmed military affairs—the memorial was rejected as excessive and set aside without deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor noted that Zeng had repeatedly accepted blame and was ordered back to handle supplies exclusively; though he had not finished the campaign, he had not harmed military affairs—the memorial was rejected as excessive and set aside.

sentences.zh: 出為山西蒲州知府，尋卒。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Puzhou in Shanxi and soon died.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as prefect of Puzhou in Shanxi and soon died.

sentences.zh: 穆緝香阿通知國故，家藏邸報，自國初以來幾備。

translations.literal: Mu Jixianga was well informed on national affairs; his family collected court gazettes, nearly complete from the founding of the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Jixianga was well versed in state affairs; his family collected court gazettes nearly complete from the dynasty's founding.

sentences.zh: =遊百川= 遊百川，字彙東，山東濱州人。

translations.literal: =You Baichuan= You Baichuan, style name Huidong, was a native of Binzhou in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: You Baichuan, whose style name was Huidong, came from Binzhou in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 同治元年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected as Hanlin bachelor, and appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Tongzhi 1 (1862), was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and appointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 六年，遷御史，巡西城。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to censor and patrolled the western city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was made censor and assigned to patrol the western city.

sentences.zh: 宗室寬和等所行多不法，奏劾懲治，一時貴近斂跡。

translations.literal: The imperial clansmen Kuanhe and others acted mostly unlawfully; he memorialized impeachment and punishment, and for a time the noble and near restrained their steps.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansmen such as Kuanhe acted unlawfully; he impeached and punished them, and for a time the privileged restrained themselves.

sentences.zh: 七年，捻匪自山東竄直隸，百川奏請飭統兵大臣迅速剿辦，又請嚴禁各省栽種罌粟，上皆採納。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Nian bandits fled from Shandong into Zhili; Baichuan memorialized urging the commanding grand minister to suppress them swiftly, and again requested strict prohibition of opium cultivation in all provinces—the emperor adopted all.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Nian bandits fled from Shandong into Zhili; Baichuan urged the commanding general to suppress them swiftly and asked for a strict ban on opium cultivation in every province—the emperor adopted both proposals.

sentences.zh: 疏論內外官署胥吏積弊，詔通飭嚴禁。

translations.literal: He memorialized on accumulated abuses of clerks in government offices within and without; an edict was issued universally ordering strict prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized on longstanding abuses by clerks in government offices; the throne issued a universal order of strict prohibition.

sentences.zh: 復言：「除吏弊在肅官方，尤在揚士氣。

translations.literal: He again stated: "Eliminating clerk abuses lies in making official conduct stern, and especially in raising the spirit of the scholar class."
translations.idiomatic: He stated further: "Eliminating clerk abuses requires strict official conduct above all, and raising the spirit of the scholar class."

sentences.zh: 請飭部院堂官於每司中擇賢俊數員，付以事權，專其責任。

translations.literal: Your servant begs that ministry and court heads in each bureau select several worthy and talented men, entrust them with authority over affairs, and fix their responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that heads of ministries and courts select several able men in each bureau, entrust them with real authority, and fix their responsibility.

sentences.zh: 察有胥吏舞弊，據實上陳，仍以勤惰定功過。

translations.literal: If clerks are found practicing fraud, report according to fact; still judge merit and fault by diligence or sloth.
translations.idiomatic: If clerks are found corrupt, report the facts; judge officials by diligence or sloth.

sentences.zh: 賞罰既明，人才自奮。

translations.literal: When rewards and punishments are clear, talent will of itself strive.
translations.idiomatic: When rewards and punishments are clear, talent will strive of itself.

sentences.zh: 至外省地方官，本有懲治胥吏之權，嚴飭各督撫為地擇人，毋以人試地。

translations.literal: As for local officials in outer provinces, they originally have power to punish clerks; strictly order each governor to choose men for the place, not try the place on men.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial officials already had power to punish clerks; governors should be ordered to choose men for the post, not assign posts to test men.

sentences.zh: 舉賢劾不肖，再簡廉正大員，以時巡察，遇有貪官蠹吏，列狀奏聞。

translations.literal: Recommend the worthy and impeach the unworthy; again select upright and incorrupt grand officials to inspect on schedule; when corrupt officials and parasitic clerks are encountered, list the facts and memorialize the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Recommend the worthy and impeach the unworthy; select upright officials for periodic inspection; when corrupt officials or parasitic clerks are found, report them to the throne.

sentences.zh: 」 黃河北徙，山東郡邑屢被水。

translations.literal: " The Yellow River shifted north, and Shandong prefectures and counties were repeatedly inundated.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River shifted north, repeatedly flooding Shandong's prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 百川疏請賑恤，河督文彬、巡撫丁寶楨請仍挽复淮、徐故道，命廷臣集議。
