translations.literal: Baichuan memorialized requesting relief; Grand Canal director Wenbin and Governor Ding Baozhen requested restoring the old Huai and Xu route, and court ministers were ordered to assemble for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Baichuan memorialized for relief; Grand Canal director Wenbin and Governor Ding Baozhen asked to restore the old Huai–Xu channel, and the court ordered deliberation.

sentences.zh: 百川疏言：「黃水宜南宜北，必將折衷一是。

translations.literal: Baichuan memorialized: "Yellow River water may suit south or north—there must be compromise to one settled policy."
translations.idiomatic: Baichuan memorialized that the Yellow River might flow south or north, but policy must settle on one course.

sentences.zh: 如議挽復故道，論工程，論經費，引黃濟運，有未可遽定者三端：如即以大清河為黃水經流，舊道斷不能容，河面必須加寬，民間田廬如何移徙，如何安置，則度地宜審也；

translations.literal: If deliberation is to restore the old course, on engineering, on expenses, and on drawing Yellow water to aid transport, there are three points not to be hastily settled: if the Daqing River is taken as the Yellow River's main channel, the old course certainly cannot contain it, the river surface must be widened—how to move and resettle common people's fields and dwellings must be carefully surveyed;
translations.idiomatic: If the old course were restored, engineering, cost, and using Yellow River water for the grain transport raised three unsettled questions: using the Daqing River as the main channel would require widening the riverbed—the old course could not hold it—and relocating countless farms and homes would need careful survey;

sentences.zh: 且即河面加寬，仍恐萬難容納，別開支河，勢不容已，徒駭、馬頰、鉤盤、鬲津猶可指名，可否開行，有無貽害，則分水宜權也；

translations.literal: moreover, even if the river surface is widened, it may still be feared it cannot contain the flow; opening branch rivers cannot be avoided—Tu Hai, Ma Jia, Gou Pan, and Ge Jin can still be named; whether they may be opened, whether harm will be left—the division of water should be weighed;
translations.idiomatic: even widened, the channel might not hold the flow; branch channels such as Tu Hai, Ma Jia, Gou Pan, and Ge Jin might be unavoidable—whether to open them and what harm might follow required careful weighing;

sentences.zh: 黃水北行，其事為創，萬一不善料理，人情騷動，物議沸騰，則相機宜慎也。

translations.literal: Yellow River water flowing north is an unprecedented affair; if by chance it is not well managed, popular feeling will be disturbed and public discussion seethe—timing must be cautious.
translations.idiomatic: Sending the Yellow River north would be unprecedented; mismanagement could stir popular unrest and public outcry—timing must be handled with utmost caution.

sentences.zh: 請特派大臣履行上下游詳勘，然後定策。

translations.literal: Your servant begs that a specially appointed grand minister travel the upper and lower reaches for detailed survey, and then fix policy.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that a senior minister be sent to survey the entire river course before policy is fixed.

sentences.zh: 」 十二年，上親政，命葺治圓明園，奉皇太后駐蹕。

translations.literal: " In the twelfth year the emperor assumed personal rule, ordered repair of the Old Summer Palace, and lodged the empress dowager there.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the emperor assumed personal rule, ordered repairs to the Old Summer Palace, and installed the empress dowager there.

sentences.zh: 御史沈淮疏請暫緩修理，上特諭宣示孝養兩宮之意，專修安佑宮供奉列聖御容，暨皇太后駐蹕之所，治事之地，量從節儉，不事華靡，此外均不必興修。

translations.literal: Censor Shen Huai memorialized requesting temporary deferral of repairs; the emperor specially instructed proclaiming the intent to honor and support both palaces, repairing only the Anyou Palace to enshrine the imperial portraits of successive sages, together with the empress dowager's lodging and place of governance, measuring by frugality without lavish display—beyond this nothing need be built.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Shen Huai asked to defer repairs; the emperor proclaimed his filial intent to honor both palaces, limiting work to the Anyou Palace for ancestral portraits, the empress dowager's residence, and offices of state—frugal and without extravagance, with no further construction.

sentences.zh: 百川繼疏申諫，上召入詰責，百川侃侃正言無所撓，上為動容，一時敢諫之名動朝野。

translations.literal: Baichuan followed with another memorial remonstrating; the emperor summoned him in and rebuked him; Baichuan spoke frankly and uprightly without wavering; the emperor was moved, and for a time the name of daring remonstrance shook court and realm.
translations.idiomatic: Baichuan remonstrated again; summoned and rebuked by the emperor, he spoke frankly without yielding; the emperor was moved, and his name for bold remonstrance resounded through the court.

sentences.zh: 尋以憂歸，服除補官，遷給事中。

translations.literal: Soon he returned home on mourning leave; when mourning ended he resumed office and was transferred to supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He soon retired for mourning; after the mourning period he resumed office and was promoted to supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 光緒五年，出為湖南衡永郴桂道，遷四川按察使，擢順天府尹，遷倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu he went out as intendant of the Heng-Yong-Chen-Gui circuit in Hunan, was transferred to Sichuan provincial judge, promoted to prefect of Shuntian, and transferred to vice minister of the Granary Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 5 (1879) he became intendant of the Heng-Yong-Chen-Gui circuit in Hunan, then Sichuan provincial judge, prefect of Shuntian, and vice minister of the Granary Circuit.

sentences.zh: 九年，山東河決，被災者數十州縣，命百川往會巡撫陳士傑治工賑。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Shandong river breached; several tens of prefectures and counties suffered disaster; Baichuan was ordered to join Governor Chen Shijie in engineering and relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Shandong river breached, inundating dozens of prefectures and counties; Baichuan was sent to join Governor Chen Shijie in relief and repair work.

sentences.zh: 百川輕騎週曆河南北岸、上下游，先散急賑。

translations.literal: Baichuan on light horse toured both banks of Henan and the upper and lower reaches, first distributing urgent relief.
translations.idiomatic: Baichuan rode through Henan's both banks and the upper and lower reaches, distributing emergency relief first.

sentences.zh: 會奏請築兩岸遙堤，复於其內築縷堤，使黃水不致氾濫；

translations.literal: Jointly they memorialized requesting dikes on both distant banks and again inner thread dikes within, so Yellow water would not overflow;
translations.idiomatic: They jointly memorialized for distant dikes on both banks and inner thread dikes within, to contain the Yellow River;

sentences.zh: 又奏請濬小清河，分黃水入海：如議行。

translations.literal: they again memorialized requesting dredging the Xiaoqing River to divide Yellow water into the sea: as proposed, enacted.
translations.idiomatic: and to dredge the Xiaoqing River to divert Yellow River water to the sea—the proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 還京，以倉廒被火，罷歸。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital, because granary storehouses caught fire he was dismissed and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Back in the capital, he was dismissed after granary storehouses burned.

sentences.zh: 居數年，卒。

translations.literal: After several years at home he died.
translations.idiomatic: After several years at home he died.

sentences.zh: （附） 沈淮 淮，字東川，浙江鄞縣人。

translations.literal: (Supplement) Shen Huai—Huai, style name Dongchuan, was a native of Yin County in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: (Supplement) Shen Huai, styled Dongchuan, came from Yin County in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 道光二十九年舉人，授內閣中書，充軍機章京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang he passed the provincial examination, was appointed Secretariat Drafter in the Grand Secretariat, and served as a clerk on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: He earned his juren degree in Daoguang 29 (1849), was appointed a Grand Secretariat drafter, and served as a Grand Council clerk.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，文宗狩熱河，淮不及從，慟哭欲投井，家人守之不得死。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng, Emperor Wenzong hunted at Rehe; Huai could not follow, wept bitterly and wished to throw himself into a well—his family guarded him and he could not die.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 10 (1860), when Emperor Xianfeng fled to Rehe, Huai could not accompany him; he wept and tried to throw himself into a well, but his family prevented his death.

sentences.zh: 遷刑部主事，進員外郎，授陝西道監察御史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to director in the Ministry of Justice, advanced to assistant department director, and appointed investigating censor for the Shaanxi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to director in the Ministry of Justice, then assistant director, and made investigating censor for the Shaanxi circuit.

sentences.zh: 疏劾戶部主事楊鴻典攬權納賄，下刑部逮治，僅以小過議鐫級，及閻敬銘為尚書，始奏劾譴黜。

translations.literal: He memorialized impeaching Revenue director Yang Hongdian for monopolizing power and taking bribes; the case was sent to the Ministry of Justice for arrest and trial, but only a minor fault was debated for demotion; when Yan Jingming became minister, impeachment and dismissal were finally memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached Revenue director Yang Hongdian for seizing power and taking bribes; the case went to the Ministry of Justice, but Yang was merely demoted for a minor fault—only when Yan Jingming became minister was he finally dismissed.

sentences.zh: 園工興，淮疏首上，當時與百川齊名。

translations.literal: When garden works were undertaken, Huai's memorial came first; at the time he was famed equally with Baichuan.
translations.idiomatic: When palace garden works began, Huai submitted the first remonstrance; at the time he was as famed as Baichuan.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，充順天鄉試監試，力疾從事，出闈，旋卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he served as examiner for the Shuntian provincial examination, working despite illness; leaving the examination compound, he soon died.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 1 (1875) he served as examiner for the Shuntian provincial examination, working through illness; he died soon after leaving the examination hall.

sentences.zh: 家固中人產，官京師，斥賣殆盡，人尤服其清節。

translations.literal: His family was originally of middling means; serving at the capital he sold off nearly everything, and people especially respected his incorruptible integrity.
translations.idiomatic: His family had been of modest means; in office at the capital he sold nearly all he owned, and people especially admired his integrity.

sentences.zh: =【論】論曰：用兵之際，事機千變，京朝官以傳聞有所論列，往往不能切中。

translations.literal: =[Commentary]= The commentary says: In times of war, affairs change by the thousand; capital officials who memorialize on the basis of hearsay often cannot strike the mark.
translations.idiomatic: [Commentary] In wartime affairs change constantly; capital officials who memorialized on hearsay often missed the mark.

sentences.zh: 宗稷辰歸重得人，尹耕雲論諸將帥罪，王拯請調和疆吏，一意辦賊，為能見其大。

translations.literal: Zong Jichen valued gaining the right men; Yin Gengyun discussed the faults of various generals; Wang Zheng requested harmonizing frontier officials and dealing with bandits single-mindedly—they could see the larger picture.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Jichen stressed recruiting talent; Yin Gengyun judged generals' failures; Wang Zheng urged coordinating frontier officials to focus on suppressing rebels—they saw the larger picture.

sentences.zh: 拯所言尤詳盡，蓋直樞廷，見軍報，較得諸傳聞者異矣。

translations.literal: Zheng's words were especially detailed and complete, for he was directly in the Grand Council and saw military reports—quite different from those who had only hearsay.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng spoke with especial detail, for he served on the Grand Council and saw military reports—unlike those who relied on rumor.

sentences.zh: 穆緝香阿請慎選宦寺，遊百川等阻修圓明園，謇謇負直諫名，良不虛也。

translations.literal: Mu Jixianga requested careful selection of eunuchs; You Baichuan and others blocked repair of the Old Summer Palace—steadfast in bearing the name of blunt remonstrance, truly not in vain.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Jixianga urged careful selection of eunuchs; You Baichuan and others blocked repairs to the Old Summer Palace—their reputations for blunt remonstrance were well deserved.
